title: Emotionally Aware Moderation: The Potential of Emotion Monitoring in Shaping Healthier Social Media Conversations
reasoning: The paper focuses on emotion regulation and monitoring to reduce hate speech in social media. While it mentions protected categories like religion in the definition of hate speech and uses moral foundations as a control variable in its methodology, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, specific moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning as a core component of its research.
